WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT 
        cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, 
        ca_state AS ctr_state, 
        SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return 
    FROM 
        catalog_returns, 
        date_dim, 
        customer_address 
    WHERE 
        cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk 
        AND d_year = 2001 
        AND cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
    GROUP BY 
        cr_returning_customer_sk, 
        ca_state
)
SELECT 
    c_customer_id, 
    c_salutation, 
    c_first_name, 
    c_last_name, 
    ca_street_number, 
    ca_street_name, 
    ca_street_type, 
    ca_suite_number, 
    ca_city, 
    ca_county, 
    ca_state, 
    ca_zip, 
    ca_country, 
    ca_gmt_offset, 
    ca_location_type, 
    ctr_total_return 
FROM 
    customer_total_return AS ctr1 
JOIN 
    customer_address ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk 
JOIN 
    customer ON customer_address.ca_address_sk = customer.c_current_addr_sk 
WHERE 
    ctr1.ctr_state = 'TN' 
    AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > 1.2 * AVG(ctr_total_return) OVER (PARTITION BY ctr_state) 
ORDER BY 
    c_customer_id, 
    c_salutation, 
    c_first_name, 
    c_last_name, 
    ca_street_number, 
    ca_street_name, 
    ca_street_type, 
    ca_suite_number, 
    ca_city, 
    ca_county, 
    ca_state, 
    ca_zip, 
    ca_country, 
    ca_gmt_offset, 
    ca_location_type, 
    ctr_total_return 
LIMIT 100
